data.content_ref: inline:The claimed sufficient bound c_{n-1}+c_n is false. For C=(6,5,1), c_{n-1}+c_n = 5+1 = 6, but the smallest counterexample is w=10: greedy gives 6+1+1+1+1 = 5 coins while optimal is 5+5 = 2 coins. All amounts 1–9 are not counterexamples (at 7,8,9 greedy is at least as good as any representation), so 10 is genuinely the smallest. Since 10 > 6, the proposed finite bound misses the smallest counterexample entirely, invalidating the decision procedure that only checks up to c_{n-1}+c_n.
